rows.en: Growster: "...Thank you for your help."
Touya: "Seriously. Getting beaten and then showing up as our enemy..."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya?!"
Growster: "Gahahahaha! It's all right.
The boy is correct. But now that I'm back to myself,
I must put right what needs putting right."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Adjutant: "...? That disc?"
Derock: "Ah! That's the disc I found
at that laboratory.
It's a bargaining chip in our favor."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Baren: "...The captain says he trusts General Growster...
I think."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Clovis: "Well, if that's how it is,
we can't object either."
Growster: "...I might turn on you and cover up the evidence.
What would you do then?"
Captain Roa: "H-Hmm..."
Yamato: "He seems stumped..."
Growster: "...Heh... Stumped, eh? Hehehehe.
I see... Gahahahaha!"
Ai: "Hey, what's wrong with that old man?
Have the drugs finally reached his brain?"
Sisk: "Hey! What if he hears you...?"
Ai: "It's fine. He's off in his own world anyway."
Growster: "...I can hear you perfectly well."
Ai: "...Urk."
Growster: "...No matter.
If that offer had come from Revios,
I'd have made trouble for him without a second thought..."
Growster: "As commander-in-chief of the Zigrim Republic Army,
I, Nagarek Growster, humbly
accept your offer."
Captain Roa: "Hmm!"
Adjutant: "Your Excellency. We'll be busy from now on."
Growster: "Indeed. I'm counting on your abilities."
Adjutant: "Yes, sir!"
Fores: "Excuse us."
Miyasco: "Oh, Fores, Reamond."
Growster: "Are you all right now?"
Reamond: "Yes. I've calmed down considerably."
Touya: "Honestly, that was reckless."
Reamond: "I'm ashamed. But as an experimental subject,
even though I was given a will, I cannot choose to take my own life.
That's how I was made..."
Touya: "So you tried to die by throwing yourself into a reckless fight?
What would that accomplish?"
Reamond: "To settle everything. To wipe out the project.
That was the only thing I was living for..."
Touya: "Even now?"
Reamond: "...No. There's someone who needs even a man like me.
I'll use the time I have left for that person...
I've become able to think that way."
Fores: "..."
Growster: "What are you blushing for?"
Fores: "Wh-Wh-wh-what are you...?!"
Growster: "Gahahahaha!"
Clovis: "Well, we'll take our leave for today.
Once things settle down, we'll probably arrange
another opportunity to talk."
Growster: "Understood. We'll make inquiries from our side too."
Clovis: "I'm counting on you. Well, shall we go?"
Touya: "See you."
Growster: "...Boy.
Don't let your guard down against ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Touya: "Heh. You don't have to tell me.
And you, don't go starting any more pointless wars!"
Growster: "Heh...
Well, everyone, I wish you success!"
Sisk: "...Oh!"
Clovis: "What's wrong?"
Sisk: "Abnormal Prana levels detected. They're increasing!
W-What are these readings...?"
Yamato: "Oh, that..."
Touya: "Yeah.
That's the machine they called a Shinkaio, right...?"
Rayfon: "...Hello. I seem to have surprised you.
...Everyone aboard the Liebhofen, it's a pleasure to meet you.
I'm Rayfon Lang Maxord..."
Sisk: "What?! You're alive! You're safe..."
Rayfon: "This transmission is one-way,
so I'd appreciate it if you'd let me aboard.
Would you open the hatch, if you don't mind?"
Sisk: "...That Armored Mech's pilot, who disappeared three years ago,
was Lord Rayfon. To think it was him."
Miyasco: "Really. To think he was alive..."
Sisk: "If His Highness were here, he might cheer up a little,
seeing Lord Rayfon...
His Highness was so down after he
went missing..."
Derock: "Oh, it seems he's here."
Touya: "You..."
Rayfon: "Hello. You made it back safely, I see."
Touya: "Yeah."
Rayfon: "I was able to get out soon after that too.
I stopped by the palace briefly, then came here.
I wish I could've come a little sooner."
Touya: "So that machine you're piloting is one of those Shinkaio
things too?"
Rayfon: "Yes. Its name is Aidion.
In the distant past, it came to Earth... The world the people there
came from, I mean."
Ai: "Huh? So... An alien machine?"
Clovis: "But why did it come to Agarthia?"
Rayfon: "To fight the huge object you say you saw.
Vorlia. The excess energy from that battle
was enough to destroy Earth.
So Aidion and the other two, Sivarius and
Coolmarishin, used their power to change the nature of that energy,
creating Agarthia.
In other words, Earth and Agarthia are two sides of the same coin.
They're one and yet different,
while still affecting each other."
Touya: "Huh?"
Rayfon: "It's sudden, so you may find it hard to believe,
but it's all true. Though it's all knowledge
Grauzer, who's inside me, taught me."
Touya: "Grauzer?"
Rayfon: "During that explosion three years ago, I should have died.
The one who saved me was a disembodied consciousness,
Grauzer.
I didn't want to die. I wanted to live.
And when I came to, Grauzer and I had merged.
We took refuge in that space through Grauzer's power."
Aurelie: "Do you mean that this Grauzer
came here aboard Aidion?"
Rayfon: "Yes. I don't fully understand it myself, but
beyond Earth is something called the universe, and farther still,
another universe exists. Apparently, that's where they came from.
Their home is called 'Lin Karma.'
They seem to share their origins with the people of the Solar System,
but that isn't certain.
Still, the people of Lin Karma and
those of the Solar System look so much alike that
the theory is probably correct.
In Lin Karma, Grauzer was the scientist who built Aidion,
Sivarius, and Coolmarishin: the three Ultra-Offensive Shell Units,
the 'Shinkaio.'"
Touya: "...I don't understand any of this..."
Ai: "So Agarthia was created in the aftermath of a battle against Vorlia,
and aliens from Lin Karma
are the ones who did it.
And the mind of one of them, Grauzer,
is living together with you inside your body.
And while we're at it, he's the one who built those three machines
standing outside?"
Rayfon: "Exactly. I think the other two will be here soon,
so I'll explain the details then."
Touya: "Hey, there's still more...?"
Clovis: "Come on, don't say that.
We're gradually getting to the truth.
Doesn't it get you excited?"
Kururu: "Wow... Bold."
Rishuna: "???"
Clovis: "Oh... So these are the two you mentioned..."
Derock: "Hmm... Quite a view..."
Rishuna: "..."
Kururu: "Lecher."
Touya: "...What are you two doing...?
Hmm? Ah! The old man from back then!"
Valga: "Oh, you managed to join up?"
Touya: "So you really are aliens from
that Lin Karma place too?"
Valga: "Yes. But unlike Rishuna here and
Grauzer, I'm in my original body."
Touya: "Your original body?"
Rishuna: "This body originally belonged to a girl named Mana Elua.
I'm 'borrowing' it.
It seems Grauzer's situation is different..."
Rayfon: "Grauzer trusts me."
Touya: "Huh... Hmm? Wait a minute...
You came here, and Agarthia was created, right?
Then how old are you, old man?"
Valga: "It's rude to ask an old man his age.
My age and my three measurements are a secret."
Touya: "What a crafty old man.
Well, anyway, you came to beat those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards
too, right?"
Rishuna: "Vorlia, not ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Ai: "Right, that Vorlia. What exactly is it?
You mentioned it earlier..."
Rayfon: "Rishuna, would you?"
Rishuna: "Yes. Certainly.
Rishuna: "...Put simply, Vorlia is a
'vessel.'
But what goes into it is the 'consciousness' of intelligent life.
Vorlia was made to collect that
consciousness.
That's why Vorlia has no will of its own.
It merely follows the order it was given: 'Collect consciousness.'
That's all it does."
Aurelie: "W-Wait. Isn't that the same as what Dr. Debish
called his 'project'?"
Rishuna: "Yes. The ≪Ze=Ode≫ Spirit Mech he pilots is
merely a peripheral organ of Vorlia..."
Ai: "I see... But who made something like that,
sent it here, and for what purpose?"
Rishuna: "We know it was sent by people from another planet,
but as for their purpose...
And that isn't the only Vorlia.
It seems they've been sent into many different universes."
Touya: "There are more of those things?!"
Rishuna: "There have been no reports of multiple Vorlia in
the same galaxy.
But we have confirmed that more than one exists.
Our Lin Karma was effectively
destroyed by Vorlia as well. Only the three of us escaped."
Touya: "This is getting pretty crazy, but
if that Vorlia comes back, does that mean everyone in this world
will disappear?"
Valga: "Yes. What Vorlia wants is information held by intelligent life
from other universes. Resources and technology
seem to be of no interest to it.
Only living beings disappear from the worlds it visits.
Vorlia is summoned when the Rayblade you pilot,
and the other ≪Ze=Ode≫ Spirit Mechs, six in all,
gather together.
Now that the path has opened again, the only way to stop it
is to destroy Vorlia itself."
Touya: "...So that's why you've shown up?
Why didn't you do anything before...?"
Rayfon: "We... Or rather, the disembodied consciousnesses inside Rishuna and me,
and Valga, somehow managed to seal Vorlia away.
Afterward, their power was spent, and they went to sleep."
Rishuna: "With Vorlia's presence as the key to awakening."
Valga: "I awoke when Goderius returned,
but Grauzer was
trapped between dimensions and couldn't act.
So Rishuna and I attacked Vorlia ourselves,
but all we could manage was to push it back.
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "That old man is laughing..."
Touya: "So what now? Will it come back again?"
Rishuna: "Probably. But Vorlia has already appeared
here once. Perhaps it could be summoned even without all six
coming together..."
Ai: "What?! Then there's nothing we can do
about it!"
Rayfon: "Now, calm down.
Several days have passed without any sign of that,
so perhaps there's some other factor involved?"
Touya: "...You make it sound like it's someone else's problem."
Rayfon: "I'm sorry if I offended you.
But ultimately, our goal is the same as yours.
We have no intention of opposing you."
Valga: "In any case, for now, all we can do is work together
to deal with this."
Xiujian: "That would help us too."
Rayfon: "Then, even if it's only for a short time, we'll be in your care."
Valga: "We shall impose on your hospitality for a while."
Rishuna: "Thank you for having us."
Murk: "Well? How is it going?"
Bernst: "No problems.
But I'm impressed you have this much equipment."
Murk: "This is my pride and joy, my private lab.
But don't tell Agarthia's assembly."
Bernst: "Yes, I understand.
If I hadn't met you, this child would probably
have died, like him..."
Murk: "Him? You had another...?"
Bernst: "Well, he was a clone.
I altered his genes a little, and he became unstable...
I did warn him."
Murk: "Could he be the one who was pulling the strings
behind the coup in the royal capital?
His name was... Cain, wasn't it?"
Bernst: "Oh, you're well informed.
You must have quite a capable informant."
Assistant: "Doctor... Aaah!"
Assistant: "Oww..."
Murk: "Honestly. How many times have I told you not to run?
There's a slight difference in the floor level there."
Bernst: "...It looks perfectly flat to me..."
Murk: "Oh, don't worry about it.
She's a little unusual."
Bernst: "Oh... Just a little...?"
Murk: "Anyway, what's got you in such a hurry?"
Assistant: "Um, well... About the person you helped,
Mr. Bernst...
He seems to be one of those ≪Ze=Ode≫ people."
Bernst: "..."
Murk: "By Bernst, do you mean the gentleman standing right there?"
Assistant: "Huh? ...Ah!"
Murk: "As careless as ever.
Oh, well.
...So, is that true?"
Bernst: "...What would you do if it were?"
Murk: "Hmm... It makes no difference to me.
I'm getting valuable data this way,
and more importantly, I like you.
Stay as long as you like."
Bernst: "..."
Murk: "My research matters more. Does that put you at ease?"
Bernst: "...I see.
For better or worse, you really are an Alchemist.
Then I'll accept your hospitality a little longer."
Murk: "Indeed. Oh, right. What happened to your Armored Mech?
If you like, I can use my Baluamy technology to make it
even more powerful."
Bernst: "...I'll pass."
